zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.10** 修会话输入框锁死一行的问题：内容会自动增高，最多 20 行；超长无空格文本会换行，而不是横向溢出。
工作台 Handle 不再就地展开合回卡，而是跳进对应会话处理。
拖宽工作台会先收起左侧栏，再进入全屏。
侧栏新增 Pin 页，置顶会话单独成表。
新建分支会推到远端；Goal 质量自检未过时可点「继续修」。
文档站 Changelog 已同步本版说明。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **输入框随内容增高**：会话态默认一行，写长了会长到最多 20 行，再长才滚动。
**侧栏 Pin 页**：工作区列表和置顶会话分 Tab，空态提示「还没有 Pin 会话」。
**工作台 Handle 跳会话**：合回/阻塞卡片点 Handle 会打开相关对话，而不是只在卡片里展开。
**工作台渐进全屏**：拖到约 60% 宽自动收左侧栏，约 80% 进入全屏。
**新建分支推远端**：源头选择器里创建的分支会立刻推到 remote。
**Goal 继续修**：质量自检没过线时，可带着这条 Goal 的 planId 继续修，而不是另开一题。

zh.title: 优化
items: 首页输入区空态更高，工作区/分支上下文行贴在输入框上方。
Goal 计划面板的下一步动作更清楚：开始、调整、取消，以及未过线时的「继续修」。

zh.title: 修复
items: 会话输入框不再锁在一行；无空格长串会换行。
重试横幅结束后不再残留，倒计时归零文案已修正。
确认弹窗输入框跟随主题底色，不再在深色界面发白。
任务启动后当前工作区会同步到任务绑定，不再停在旧值。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本 GitHub Release 同时发布 CLI 归档，版本与 Desktop 相同。
一等产物：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz`（内含 `peer` 与 `peer-credential-helper`，**必须同目录**）。
可通过 `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`）安装正式通道版本；`postinstall` 会拉取本版归档。
也可手动解压归档，将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验后运行 `peer`。
CLI 与 Desktop 继续共享 `~/.peer-agent` 下的会话和设置。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.10** unsticks the conversation composer: it grows with the draft, up to 20 lines, and wraps long unspaced strings instead of overflowing sideways.
Workbench Handle no longer expands a merge card in place — it opens the related conversation.
Dragging the workbench wider first collapses the sidebar, then goes fullscreen.
The sidebar adds a Pin tab so pinned chats live in their own list.
Newly created branches are pushed to the remote; Goals that fail quality review can Continue fixing.
The docs-site Changelog includes this release.

en.title: Features
items: **Composer auto-grows**: conversation input starts at one line and grows to 20 lines before scrolling.
**Sidebar Pin tab**: workspaces and pinned chats are separate tabs, with an empty “No pinned chats yet” state.
**Handle jumps to the conversation**: merge/blocked cards open the related thread instead of expanding locally.
**Progressive workbench fullscreen**: around 60% width collapses the left sidebar; around 80% enters fullscreen.
**New branches push remotely**: branches created in the source picker are pushed to the remote immediately.
**Continue fixing a Goal**: when quality review has not passed, continue on the same planId instead of starting a new topic.

en.title: Improvements
items: Empty-home composer is taller, with workspace/branch context sitting above the input.
Goal next actions are clearer: start, adjust, cancel, and Continue fixing when checks are still missing.

en.title: Fixes
items: The conversation composer is no longer locked to one overflowing row; unspaced strings wrap.
Retry banners no longer linger after a terminal state; zero-countdown copy is corrected.
Confirm-dialog inputs follow the theme fill instead of flashing white on dark UI.
Starting a task syncs the active workspace to the task binding instead of leaving a stale value.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships CLI archives under the same tag / version as Desktop.
First-class assets: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz` (contains `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`; they **must stay in the same directory**).
Install the stable channel with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`); `postinstall` downloads this release's archive.
Alternatively, unpack an archive manually, add its directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, and then run `peer`.
CLI and Desktop continue to share sessions and settings under `~/.peer-agent`.
